defense.notes: Roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add to AC against the triggering attack.

offense.notes: Roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the result to the attack's damage.

Combat Inspiration.notes: Creatures with your Bardic Inspiration can use the die for offensive or defensive combat boosts.

Martial Training.notes: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons, Medium armor, and Shields, and you can use weapons as a Spellcasting Focus.

Extra Attack.notes: You can attack twice when taking the Attack action, and you may replace one attack with a cantrip that has a casting time of an action.

Battle Magic.notes: After casting a spell with a casting time of an action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
